summary: Added sdk/journal.py: frozen GameplayEvent (alias, action id, attempt id, tz-aware start and finish, outcome, reason, attempted, expected effect, response_ok, error_class, dry_run, params, cost, schema_version) and an append-only, fsynced GameplayJournal. Params are redacted with sdk.redaction.redact_dict, and an event whose serialised form still matches a redaction pattern is refused. read_events ignores an interrupted final line and raises on any other malformed line. summarize() returns per-account attempted, verified, not_observed, contradicted, uncertain, failed and skipped counts. Added 10 tests using temporary directories, and docs/baseline/gameplay-journal.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Action outcomes exist only in free-text log files
contract_status_changes.after: Structured, redacted, append-only per-attempt events with per-account outcome summaries

residual_risks: Concurrent writers to one journal file are not locked; the runner should use one writer per journal.
Secret detection relies on sdk.redaction patterns; a secret format those patterns miss would be written.
